description: This file defines the UnauthorizedException class within the OrangeHRM Authentication exception namespace. The class extends the base Exception class and encapsulates a Response object, providing custom behavior for unauthorized access errors in the application.

classes.name: UnauthorizedException
classes.description: Custom exception representing unauthorized access, containing a Response object for further handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UnauthorizedException with a Response object, message, code, and previous Throwable.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the Response object associated with the exception.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the Response object for the exception.
